policies.callerValidationFragment:
<!-- Validates the caller's Microsoft Entra token and requires a specific Object ID (oid).
     The permitted identity is supplied by the API or Product policy. -->
<fragment>
	<validate-azure-ad-token tenant-id="EXAMPLE_TENANT_ID" header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="Unauthorized">
		<audiences>
			<audience>api://EXAMPLE_API_APPLICATION_ID</audience>
		</audiences>
		<required-claims>
			<claim name="oid" match="any">
				<value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("allowedCallerObjectId", ""))</value>
			</claim>
		</required-claims>
	</validate-azure-ad-token>
	<set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="delete" />
</fragment>
policies.getOperation:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@((string)context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true)["method"] != "GET")">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="400" reason="Invalid Method" />
          <set-body>{"error":"This endpoint only allows GET."}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <set-method id="apim-generated-policy">POST</set-method>
    <rewrite-uri template="/HTTP_Request/paths/invoke?api-version=2016-06-01" />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
    <authentication-managed-identity resource="api://EXAMPLE_API_APPLICATION_ID" ignore-error="false" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
policies.modifyOperation:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@{
                var body = context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true);
                var method = (string)body["method"];
                var action = (string)body["action"];

                return method != "PATCH" ||
                    (action != "Disable" &&
                     action != "DisableReset" &&
                     action != "Enable");
            }">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="400" reason="Invalid Method" />
          <set-body>{"error":"This endpoint only allows PATCH with Disable, DisableReset, or Enable."}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <set-method id="apim-generated-policy">POST</set-method>
    <rewrite-uri template="/HTTP_Request/paths/invoke?api-version=2016-06-01" />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
    <authentication-managed-identity resource="api://EXAMPLE_API_APPLICATION_ID" ignore-error="false" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
